_comment: The kinds of race (see Services/Race/RaceFormats.cs and docs/modding.md, formats). family: drag (the strips; the
drag record, wagers and milestones) or road (every other track). module: the race mode's Lua module that runs it
(format_<module>.lua in apps/new-modes/sc_race, or formats/<module>.lua in a mod). laps: what the race is over, an
event may set its own; sessionLaps: what AC's session is given when the format runs past its laps; outLap: a lap is run before
its laps (a warm-up: never raced on an A-to-B layout then). win: position
(first over the line) or score (participants[].score in the result, better: lower or higher; scoreShows: time for
milliseconds shown as a lap time, else points). name: its name's text
key (paper.race_type.<id> when left out). diner: offered at the diner; street: raced on the street (the last of each
family). rivals: the most rivals one race of it takes (an event's field; 1, one on one, when left out; 20 at most,
and a drag race is always 1). aliases: the race types events and saves named before formats.
